title: Formulator Pen: open-source gravimetric dispensing of high-viscosity liquids on a tool-changing gantry
description: Hardware design, firmware, orchestration software, raw gravimetric data and analysis code of the Formulator-Pen, a syringe-based positive-displacement dispenser for viscous liquids (1-69,080 cP) deployed as exchangeable, material-specific tools on a Cartesian gantry for self-driving laboratories.
